research_topic: Multimodal Few-Shot Learning Generalization Performance Optimization Implement Cross-Modal Meta-Learning framework combining EfficientNet and DistilBERT with cross-modal attention to achieve 25% improvement in few-shot classification accuracy (1-shot, 5-shot) on Meta-Dataset (https://github.com/google-research/meta-dataset), miniImageNet, and CIFAR-FS, targeting 70%+ 5-shot accuracy and 60%+ cross-domain generalization against MAML, Prototypical Networks, Relation Networks, and CLIP zero-shot baselines.
